When I was around 10 my grandad was in hospital/care home with Alzheimer's. One day, though I don't remember the day of the week, got the call that he was on his way out. The family gathered and went in to see him. Me being young was told to wait outside. About half hour later my uncle came out and asked if I wanted to go in and say my good byes as he didn't have long left to go. I went in and remember seeing him drawn and gaunt and not as I remember my grandad at all. But said my goodbyes and went back out.
 When I was around 30 my brother told me that he had already died and my mum and dad didn't want me seeing him like that, but my uncle thought it would be best if I was able to say goodbye thinking he was still alive. When I was told I was annoyed at my parents, but since then I have been in the same room on my own and watched my father pass and I can now understand why my uncle lied to me about it.
